description: New exit path for abandoned tasks: `task.py deprecate` plus a `deprecate-task` entry point on Claude Code and Codex.
changelog:
**Features:**
- feat(scripts): new `task.py deprecate <task> [--reason <text>]` retires a task that should not continue — wrong direction, cancelled requirement, gone obsolete. It prepends a `## DEPRECATED` banner (date + reason) to `prd.md` / `design.md` / `implement.md`, records `meta.deprecated` / `deprecatedAt` / `deprecatedReason` in `task.json`, then archives through `cmd_archive`, so the directory move, session-pointer cleanup, `after_archive` hooks and the archive commit all stay on one code path. Re-running on an already-banner-marked doc is a no-op, so banners never stack. The guard that refuses a target outside `.trellis/tasks/` runs *before* any write, so a mistyped name (`deprecate src`) cannot drop a banner into a production file.
- feat(scripts): the archived `task.json` still carries `status="completed"` — `cmd_archive` owns that field and this release introduces no new terminal state. `meta.deprecated` plus the doc banner are what tell a later reader (or agent) that the task produced no deliverable. Known consequence: an abandoned child task still counts as done in its parent's `[n/m done]` counter, since that counter treats anything absent from the active set as complete. Parent and children are expected to be dropped as a family.
- feat(commands): new `deprecate-task` entry point — `/trellis:deprecate-task` on Claude Code, a `trellis-deprecate-task` skill on Codex, both rendered from one `templates/common/commands/deprecate-task.md`. It confirms the target with the user, calls `task.py deprecate`, and records a journal entry with `--commit -` because no work commit belongs to a deprecation. It fires only on an explicit drop request (`废弃` / `放弃` / `方向错了` / `需求取消` / `不做了` / deprecate / abandon / drop), never on a task that merely looks stale.
- feat(scripts): code left behind by an abandoned task is deliberately out of scope — `deprecate` never inspects or modifies the working tree, commits, or branches, and says so in the entry point so the AI surfaces the leftovers instead of reverting them on its own. Archive's commit path already stages only the task's own paths, so unrelated dirty files cannot be swept into it.
notes:
No files are renamed or deleted — `--migrate` is not needed.

After `trellis update`, drop a task with `/trellis:deprecate-task` on Claude Code or by asking for the `trellis-deprecate-task` skill on Codex; `python3 ./.trellis/scripts/task.py deprecate <task> --reason "<why>"` is the direct CLI form.

Whether the archive step produces a `chore(task): archive ...` commit follows `session_auto_commit` in `.trellis/config.yaml` (off by default), exactly as a normal archive does.
